verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe defining Fact Tables/metrics computed directly from the customer's own warehouse (growthbook-docs-9), warehouse-native support for 11 data sources like BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks (growthbook-gh-3/7), and independent community corroboration contrasting this with black-box event-push models like Optimizely (growthbook-comm-5). Missing for 10: explicit product documentation on defining metrics from ingested/streamed events (only warehouse tables are directly documented) and a first-party walkthrough of the metric-authoring UI beyond Fact Tables.
